dashboard.waiting_one: One person is waiting to meet you.
dashboard.waiting_many: :count people are waiting to meet you.
dashboard.chosen: Chosen for you by our matching, not by browsing. Open one whenever you're ready.
dashboard.no_browsing: Chosen for you — RealVows has no profile browsing.
dashboard.searching_heading: We haven't found someone we'd stand behind yet.
dashboard.searching_body: We would rather send you nobody than send you the wrong person. As soon as someone meets the bar, they will be here.
dashboard.all_open_body: When you would like more, they are here. There is no rush, and nothing expires.
dashboard.ready: Your profile is ready, and it stays ready.

verification.pending_heading: Your profile is with our team.
verification.pending_body: A real person is reviewing it — usually within a day. We will email you when it is done, and your introductions will be waiting.
verification.incomplete_body: You are :percent% of the way there. Once it is complete and verified, we start looking.

match.why: Why we chose them for you

packages.heading: Open the ones you want.
packages.reassurance: Your profile is ready and it stays ready. Introductions do not expire, there is nothing recurring, and nobody is removed while you think about it.
packages.one_payment: One payment. Nothing recurring, and nothing expires — open them whenever you are ready.
packages.card_safety: Your card details go straight to the payment provider. They never touch RealVows.

checkout.do_not_close: This can take a moment. Please do not close this window or press back.
checkout.not_charged: You have not been charged. There is nothing to cancel and nothing to claim back.
checkout.untouched: Your profile is untouched and your introductions are still waiting.
checkout.decline_generic: The payment did not go through, and nothing was charged. It is worth trying again — if it happens twice, your bank will know why.
checkout.decline_bank: Your bank declined the payment. They did not say why, and nothing was charged. A different card usually works.
checkout.decline_expired: That card has expired. Nothing was charged.
checkout.decline_unknown_card: That card number was not recognised. Nothing was charged.
checkout.decline_timeout: We did not hear back from your bank in time, so we stopped and charged nothing.

credits.none_left: You have no introductions left to open.
credits.already_open: That introduction is already open. You were not charged twice.

report.heading: Report a concern
report.privacy: This goes to a person on our team. :name is never told.
report.thanks: Thank you. Someone will look at this.

reasons.misrepresented_identity: They are not who they say they are
reasons.inappropriate_content: Something in their profile is inappropriate

account.this_is_where_your: This is where your matches are sent by WhatsApp.
account.your_email_is_how: Your email is how you sign in, so it cannot be changed here. Write to support and we will move it for you.
account.your_profile_stays_exactly: Your profile stays exactly as it is.
account.email_matches: Email me when there is someone new
account.whatsapp_note: We'll use this once WhatsApp delivery is switched on.
account.receipts_note: Always sent. A receipt for money you have paid is a record you are entitled to, so there is nothing to switch off here.

purchases.heading: Purchase history
purchases.empty_body: Your receipts will appear here once you open your first introduction.

auth.one_click_signs_you: One click signs you straight in. Password for every account is
auth.register_heading: Join people who are serious about marriage.
auth.register_free: Sign up is completely free. Build your entire profile without paying anything.
auth.age_confirm: I confirm I am 18 years of age or older
auth.forgot_body: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link.
auth.forgot_sent_body: We've sent a reset link to your address. It expires in one hour.
auth.reset_body: Pick something you haven't used here before.

profile.a_photo_of_you: A photo of you holding a handwritten note with the code below. A real person checks this — it's how we keep every profile genuine.
profile.these_are_absolute_anyone: These are absolute. Anyone they apply to is removed before any scoring happens, so choose only what you genuinely could not live with.
profile.whatsapp_destination: We send your matches here by WhatsApp.
profile.change_in_account: Need to change either of these? You can do it from your account settings.
profile.values_prompt: Your five core values, most important first
profile.on_disagreement: When you disagree with someone close to you
profile.prompts_are_hints: Those prompts are only there to help you start — write it however you like.
profile.no_better_end: There is no better end of any of these. Put the marker where it honestly falls.
profile.body_types: Body types you are open to
profile.leave_unticked: Leave them all unticked if you would rather not narrow this.

inbox.heading: Your introductions
inbox.chosen_for_you: Everyone here was chosen for you. There is nothing to browse.
inbox.empty_all: Your introductions will appear here as we find them. There is nothing to search — we do the looking.
inbox.empty_waiting: Nothing waiting just now. New introductions arrive as we find them.
inbox.empty_interested: You have not said yes to anyone yet.
inbox.empty_passed: You have not passed on anyone yet.

demo.banner: Everyone here is invented and the sign-in buttons are open — not the live platform.

offline.heading: You're offline.
offline.body: Your matches are safe — we'll bring them back when you reconnect.
